files.content:
# Pixel Flood-Fill

A small offline color puzzle built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

## Run

Open `index.html` in a modern browser. No server, installation, or network connection is needed.

## Play

Choose one of the three colors, then click any tile. The same-color area connected to that tile fills with your chosen color. Connections are up, down, left, and right; diagonal tiles do not connect. Each effective fill counts as one move. Fill the grid with one color to see **One color!** Use **Start over** to restore the fixed starting pattern.

All controls are buttons and can be operated with a keyboard. Use Tab to move between controls and Enter or Space to activate them.
